_comment: Default PocketTerm35 keymap. CAPTURED FROM HARDWARE 2026-09-01, not guessed.
Two independent passes over all 12 controls produced identical codes.
Seeds /var/lib/tracer/settings.json on first boot. Once seeded, the live
file wins — edit the mapping from Settings > Button mapping, not here.
hid_usage is recorded for provenance: it is the raw USB HID usage the
RP2040 sends, so a firmware change on the Pico is diagnosable by comparing
against it rather than guessing why a button moved.

match.name: My Company My Custom Pico Keyboard

_typeable_note: typeable=true marks a button bound to a key that also produces a character.
A, B, X, Y, L, R are the literal QWERTY letters, so in nav mode they must be
swallowed, and in text mode they must pass through as text. tracerd.input is
modal for exactly this reason — see docs/controls.md#modal-input.
start and select are the ONLY two buttons that are not typeable. That makes
them the only safe universal escapes out of text mode, which is why select
is bound to the mode toggle.

nav.description: Default. Typeable keys are consumed as buttons.

text.description: Terminal, or any focused text field. Keys pass through verbatim.
